(853 minutes) |discs= |cassettes= |pages= |isbn=9780593460795 |timeline=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]'' |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Shatterpoint''''' is the unabridged audio version of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Shatterpoint (novel)|novel]] of the same name by author [[Matthew Stover]]. The audiobook was performed by [[Sullivan Jones]] and was released by [[Random House Audio]] on [[June 15]], [[2021]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''. An unabridged (17 minutes) recording of the the short story "[[Equipment (short story)|Equipment]]", also written by Stover, follows the novel.
